title: Influence under coordinate restriction
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $J\subseteq[n]$, and let $i\in J$. Averaging over all assignments to the coordinates outside $J$, the influence of the extended restriction of $f$ to the free coordinates in $J$ at coordinate $i$ equals the influence of $f$ at $i$.
